title: Visual and anatomical outcomes associated with treat-and-extend administration of intravitreal aflibercept for neovascular age-related macular degeneration

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License; CC0 1.0 dedication for data)

groups.description: Treatment-naive neovascular AMD, intravitreal aflibercept monthly for 3 months, then treat-and-extend (routine practice)

exclusions.what: Tab1 BCVA rows: baseline (R1), post-treatment at 6 and 12 months (R3-R4) and mean change at 6 and 12 months (R6-R7)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set (protocol inclusion 5; brief ruling on complete-case statements): eyes with follow-up less than 12 months were excluded (Methods), a minimum follow-up equal to the last tabulated visit (12 months); the article does not state that every treated eye completed the follow-up. No admissible series remains.

exclusions.what: Tab1 proportions of eyes gaining 0.3 logMAR or more and of eyes reaching 0.3 logMAR or better (R9-R10, R12-R13)
Tab2 regression coefficients; Tab3 summary of other studies
exclusions.reason: Regression coefficients and values of other studies are not extracted.

notes: BCVA was collected in Snellen units and converted to logMAR and ETDRS letters (Methods).
